title: DSLR wrapper dereferences a failed LibRaw initialization
summary: Wrapper accesses raw_data->params without checking the allocation result. Next: guard init, return a clear allocation error and cover injected initialization failure.
evidence: indigo_libs/indigo_dslr_raw.c:150-153; LibRaw C init API returns NULL on allocation failure.
